acceptance.source: User direction: match Front styling with BackIntel content; docs/design/decision-workspace-concept.md and docs/design/decision-workspace-reference-lock.json.
outcomes: Reviewers can inspect a case, open original evidence, save a reasoned decision, inspect its history, and then see the later outcome.
React and Reflex use the same versioned records and durable local review store.
The compact lavender navigation, queue, reader, contextual evidence drawer and bottom composer follow the approved Front reference.
Public facts, rule-based suggestions, experimental predictions and simulated equipment records remain distinct.
Desktop and mobile workflows work; source changes and concurrent reviews cannot silently overwrite a decision.
All Python unit modules pass with isolated test databases; React build, unit tests and pinned Fallow checks pass.
invariants: This local frontend demonstration makes no collection or provider/model calls.
Reviews belong to the source fingerprint that the reviewer saw.
Missing browser evidence blocks readiness. Screenshots and observations must belong to the exact candidate.
The separate platform acceptance and real-model evaluation requirements remain in the root validation contract.
forbiddenOutcomes: Do not present experimental predictions as useful or accurate.
Do not claim user acceptance, publication, deployment or measured business savings from these checks.
